title: HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to removing the property at 9 East 19th Avenue (Case Nos. 619017, 801964), Assessor I.D. No. 4226-011-009,…
text:
[Council File 26-0005-S182; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to removing the property at 9 East 19th Avenue (Case Nos. 619017, 801964), Assessor I.D. No. 4226-011-009, from the Rent Escrow Account Program (REAP).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
APPROVE the Housing Department (LAHD) report dated October 9, 2026, attached to the Council file, and ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTION removing the property at 9 East 19th Avenue (Case Nos. 619017, 801964), Assessor I.D. No. 4226-011-009, from the REAP.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the LAHD. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Housing Department proposal to take 9 East 19th Avenue in Council District 11 off the Rent Escrow Account Program.
